description: Source code for managing hostapd configuration files, including loading, creating, modifying, and saving configurations, with support for multiple VAPs and BSS sections.

methods.name: s_createHostapdVapInfo
methods.description: Creates a vap map for interface/bss section, allocating and initializing a wld_hostapdVapInfo_t structure.

methods.name: s_deleteHostapdVapInfo
methods.description: Deletes a vap map for interface/bss section, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: s_initConfig
methods.description: Allocates and initializes wld_hostapd_config_t structure from the vap list.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_createConfig
methods.description: Creates a wld_hostapd_config_t structure from Radio and Vaps configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads hostapd configuration from a file into wld_hostapd_config_t structure.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the content of hostapd configuration into a file.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value parameter in the configuration map.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_delConfigParam
methods.description: Deletes a key-value parameter from the configuration map.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMap
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration map for general or specific BSS/VAP.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamValStr
methods.description: Gets the string value of a configuration parameter.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMapByBssid
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration map for a specific BSSID.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamByBssidValStr
methods.description: Gets the string value of a configuration parameter for a specific BSSID.
